posts.description: This was initially some advice I wrote for some governments early in the COVID era. I then turned it into a blog post, but we never got round to publishing it. Every six months or so I find myself referencing it. I think it’s even more true in a world of generative AI and agentic interactions. So it was time it got a URL. posts.title: 'The end of programming' means untangling is just getting started
posts.description: In a recent post, Paul Dix makes a case for “the end of programming.” Looking at the rapid evolution of AI agents and the massive, AI-driven Rust rewrite of Bun, he argues that the manual writing and line-by-line reviewing of code is headed for extinction. posts.title: Digital Sovereignty: The Power to Decide
posts.description: I’ve spent a lot of the past years in rooms where someone asks a version of the same question: how did we end up this dependent, and what can we actually do about it? The urgency of the question has grown as geopolitical certainties have slipped away and as AI has grown to dominate the conversation.
